message.content: Hunting for tunneling and boundary breaks — testing fast bodies against thin walls first.
Thin-wall tunneling held, so I'll probe other high-speed and bounce extremes.
Early energy violation found — shrinking it to the minimal failing case.
Shrunk to a single fast body — replaying to confirm before diagnosing the energy gain.
Replay confirmed deterministic. Now inspecting the violating state to pin down the cause.
Velocity looks far too large for the gravity setting — checking earlier steps to trace the growth.
Vy is far too large for gravity alone, suggesting a substep integration error. Checking mid-run states to confirm.
Vy dropped far more than gravity allows in one step — testing whether a smaller dt removes the failure.
Small-dt control passes, so gravity substepping is the culprit. Gathering one more state for the report.
